lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed high-intensity local maxima are arranged in approximately 5-6 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with roughly equidistant vertical spacing between primary blobs within each column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a geometric grid where the blobs serve as anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least one clear horizontal ridge feature is visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a dense, stochastic arrangement of smaller high-luminance spots that contrasts with the more ordered grid patterning of the flank.
